claims.claim_en: Verb (imperfect) with future prefix 'سـ' + 3pl suffix: 'they will attain/receive/it will befall them' (i.e. they will suffer/be visited by)
Root meaning: 'anger/wrath' — here specifically punitive divine wrath
Root meaning: 'rabb' = Lord / Master / Sustainer (here 'their Lord')
Root meaning: 'humiliation/abasement' — here manifested as exile, subjugation and lowliness
Idiomatic collocation 'al-ḥayāh ad-dunyā' = 'this worldly life' (temporal, worldly existence contrasted with the afterlife); here 'humiliation in this life'
Those who fabricate lies / the slanderers (here: the ones who falsely accuse or lie about God)
